name: Punisher MAX
description: Frank Castle wages a one-man war against the criminal underworld with brutal efficiency and zero compromise. No superpowers, no mercy—just a soldier who decided that the system failed and took justice into his own hands.
flavorText: One man. One war. No rules.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Pursuit / Escape. One-man Punisher war on crime with zero mercy. Driving strings and relentless percussion. Gritty and unstoppable, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
